summary: The trigger-efficiency term, one per-period estimate shared by both species, is propagated as independent in the numerator and denominator of the ratio instead of cancelling, overstating the ratio uncertainty.
code_change: ratio_block(): the trigger blocks of both species are added to the relative covariance.
description_change: measurement spec: ratio cancellation trigger_efficiency now treatment 'independent', correlation model 'trigger efficiency estimated per species'.
